title: PCSO distributes mobility aids, hygiene kits in Baliwag, Bulacan

blocks.text: The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) distributed mobility aids and hygiene kits to persons with disabilities (PWDs), senior citizens, and other residents of Baliwag, Bulacan on October 6, 2026, as part of its continuing effort to provide essential assistance to vulnerable communities. The outreach activity was led by PCSO Director Jennifer Liongson-Guevara, who personally oversaw the turnover of wheelchairs, canes, and hygiene kits to qualified recipients. The assistance aims to help improve the beneficiaries’ mobility, promote personal hygiene and enhance the recipients’ overall quality of life.
